description: Machine-readable public character canon for Tidefall Academy, the original fantasy series and world also known as Tidefall.

coreFour.name: Jasper Holloway
coreFour.role: Central character and Tidefall Academy student

magic.notes: Jasper uses the wandless magical system of Tidefall and has a strong connection to awareness, the Tide and Titans.

relationships.Lily Hart: Close bond, shared fuller Titan-sense and eventual later-series pairing.
relationships.Harper Vale: Jasper's analysis balances Harper's instinct and momentum.
relationships.Ava Rees: Both are observers; Jasper follows possibilities while Ava checks evidence and precision.

coreFour.name: Lily Hart
coreFour.role: Central character, late-entry Tidefall Academy student and member of the core four
coreFour.groupRole: Late arrival whose confidence and sense of belonging develop across the story
coreFour.beforeTidefall: Lily was bullied and experienced an uncontrolled magical eruption under pressure before being brought to Tidefall Academy later than most students.
coreFour.choosingTide: During Lily's unusual late placement, the Tide began carrying her toward a different destination. Lily resisted and swam against it, and a dolphin became part of the crossing before she reached Brannor.

magic.notes: Lily's magic can become especially intense under pressure.

relationships.Jasper Holloway: Close bond, shared fuller Titan-sense and eventual later-series pairing.
relationships.Harper Vale: Harper's confidence and momentum contrast with Lily's early caution.
relationships.Ava Rees: Ava's precision helps define chaos while Lily brings emotional and intuitive awareness.

coreFour.name: Harper Vale
coreFour.role: Central character and Tidefall Academy student

magic.notes: Harper's challenge is often controlling exactly how much magic happens rather than making magic happen at all.

coreFour.tideConnection: A major early event involves Harper falling and being rescued by the Tide, reinforcing that the Tide can act as more than ordinary water.

relationships.Jasper Holloway: Harper's momentum balances Jasper's analysis and caution.
relationships.Lily Hart: Harper's confidence contrasts with Lily's early caution, while Lily brings emotional awareness.
relationships.Ava Rees: Strong opposites: Harper is instinct-first and momentum-driven; Ava is precision-first and evidence-driven.

coreFour.name: Ava Rees
coreFour.role: Central character and Tidefall Academy student

magic.notes: Ava treats magical progress as something that can be tested, adjusted, repeated and improved.

relationships.Jasper Holloway: Both are observers; Ava checks evidence and precision while Jasper follows patterns and possibilities.
relationships.Lily Hart: Ava brings structure and definition while Lily brings emotional and intuitive awareness.
relationships.Harper Vale: Strong opposites: Ava is precision-first and evidence-driven; Harper is instinct-first and momentum-driven.

sharedCanon.orderPlacement: The Choosing Tide carries students toward the Order it chooses.

titanSense.description: An exceptionally rare ability connected to Titans.
titanSense.limitedForm: Associated with hearing rather than the same complete connection.

sharedCanon.relationshipPolicy: The core four remain a tight friendship group with low relationship drama. Jasper and Lily are an eventual later-series pairing.

disambiguation: This data describes Tidefall Academy, the original fantasy series and world at tidefall.com.au, also known as Tidefall. Unrelated works, games, books, places or projects using the name Tidefall have separate lore.
